summary: Expanded backend + mobile-web verification for shared-v1-2026-09-11 with new reviewed PDF lifecycle tests, auth/query race/guard tests, and refreshed unauth mobile UI checks on public preview.

minor.issue: Flaky AutoReconnect/connection closed observed during full-suite runs (26/27 pass in retry run; single setup/runtime failure is intermittent infrastructure instability, not deterministic app logic).

integration_issues.flow: Authenticated role-based workspace flows (admin/telecaller/billing/customer) including real signed-in panel/requests/rates/directory/pdf-import journeys
integration_issues.issue: Not executed end-to-end in this run on public preview because isolated synthetic UI session routing/proxy-to-loopback ASGI harness was not provisioned in this iteration.

action_items: Provision isolated authenticated UI sessions/proxy harness (loopback ASGI + synthetic DB) and run full mobile signed-in route coverage for admin/telecaller/billing/customer as requested.
Investigate intermittent Mongo AutoReconnect in CI/container during larger shared suite runs; add resilient fixture retry/backoff around index creation and first auth calls.
Continue parser negative coverage for malformed/encrypted/scanned/rotated/tall-image variants beyond current fixture set and attach rendered page/crop evidence for each class.
Execute remaining import-job chaos permutations against real transient storage-failure simulation with explicit retry telemetry and recovery proof.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is very large (>3000 lines), violating maintainability threshold; split into focused modules to reduce regression risk.
backend/server.py and frontend/login.tsx include fallback defaults (e.g., DB_NAME and hardcoded enrollment URL), conflicting with strict env-only fail-fast contract.
frontend/src/api.ts uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL key path while the environment contract in this task references EXPO_BACKEND_URL; alignment should be enforced.
frontend/app/panel.tsx contains stale/dead paths (e.g., legacy PDF import branch after early return), increasing confusion and testability risk.

success_rate.backend: 96.3% on full-suite retry (26/27) with intermittent infra error; targeted new suite 10/10 passed
success_rate.frontend: 55% (mobile public-preview load, unauth guards, verify-otp-error selector validated; authenticated role workflows pending)

seed_data_creation: Synthetic isolated Mongo test data only (ephemeral shared_test_* DBs dropped after tests). No production/public DB mutation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: MOCKED: SMS transport and object storage were intercepted only in isolated backend tests via fixture monkeypatching. Public preview frontend was tested only for unauth/guard/verify-otp UI surfaces. Physical Android/iOS native and release-build flows remain unverified.
rca_of_issue: Main uncovered risk is test-environment gap for authenticated UI, not yet a confirmed business-logic defect: required signed-in role workflows need isolated synthetic sessions + API forwarding harness. Intermittent Mongo AutoReconnect suggests infrastructure instability under repeated isolated DB setup; reproduction seen in full shared-suite runs where setup/indexing or first auth write occasionally fails with connection closed.
